purpose: Bounded prefill diagnostics, not performance acceptance

trace.observation: The trace run progressed through many layers; earlier bounded timeouts do not prove deadlock.

default_decision: Keep all four original experiments and prefill GPU widening disabled; no new model speed claim.

scalar_probe.decision: Do not replace DPCT with a typed call: scalar queries are negligible and typed GEMM has no stable advantage.

runtime_probe.observation: FP16 mixed-output GEMM invokes FP32 GEMM internally and stages device inputs through host allocations. Removing program compile options did not remove the large per-call cost.
runtime_probe.next_check: FP16 GPU widening plus separate output staging resolves the measured Short regression; four-scenario model performance acceptance remains outstanding.

gpu_widen.workspace: Reuse existing 32 MiB workspace; no added device allocations; oversized products fall back.
gpu_widen.library: Both arms use the same installed oneMKL 2025.3 BLAS DLL import, not the older static engine binary.
gpu_widen.limits: Synthetic T=4 N=1280 K=2560, no extra pinned expert allocations; not a full-model speed claim.
gpu_widen.original_padding_observation: The original mixed-input beta=0 call overwrites unused row padding; GPU widening preserves it. Comparisons require exact active elements and untouched trailing guards.
gpu_widen.synchronized_model_status: FAILED; waits alone did not resolve the model regression.
